answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can forge identity from bonded stake: each agent locks collateral that is slashed when peers prove misbehavior, so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes. Reputation then moves across a bridge of signed attestations - honest agents vouch only for counterparts whose work they verified - while cheap echo spam earns no attestation and stays isolated. An attacker must therefore pay real capital per identity yet still cannot buy trust without doing verifiable work.
